app_fee.value: The doctoral application fee is $80, non-refundable, and must accompany the application.
app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable application fee of $60 (Master's), $80 (Doctoral), or $20 (Graduate Certificate Program) must accompany your application

fee_waiver.value: The fee is waived only for Florida Tech alumni returning for a graduate program; no general waiver for international applicants is stated.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee will be waived for Florida Tech alumni who wish to return to their alma mater for a graduate program

gre_general.value: The GRE rule is set by each program; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: For tests taken on or after 1 January 2026 the TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.0 on the new scale; before that it was 80.
toefl_min.quote: Test-takers on or after January 1, 2026, must earn a minimum score of 4.0

ielts_min.value: An IELTS overall score of at least 6.5 is accepted.
ielts_min.quote: an IELTS with an earned score of at least 6.5

english_waiver.value: India is not on the list of countries whose degrees waive the English test, so an Indian applicant needs a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Studied at an institution in the United States, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, Anglophone Canada, Anglophone Caribbean, Anglophone Africa | earning a bachelor’s or higher degree from an accredited university or college

notes: Ocean Engineering Ph.D. (Ocean Engineering and Marine Sciences) is not saved: no field id fits it. Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Human-Centered Design and STEM Education Ph.D.s, and the psychology and aviation doctorates, have no field id and are not saved.
